in_arabic.name: Nujaid
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nujaid هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'najada' which means 'to help, aid or support'. This name signifies generosity, kindness and a willingness to help others. In Islamic history, it is associated with the virtues of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions.
